title: Multiport photonic routing with a single cavity-based electro-optic phase shifter per port
abstract: Programmable photonic meshes can perform general linear transformations, but universal transformations on $N$ modes require $O(N^2)$ programmable phase shifters, which cannot simultaneously achieve low drive voltage, gigahertz speed, zero static power, lossless modulation, and a compact footprint. Signal routing does not require universal transformations, which allows considerable circuit simplifications. We present a compact reflective circuit architecture that connects all input-output pairs across $N$ modes in $N$ steps using only $O(N)$ programmable phase shifters. The circuit comprises a single passive $N\times N$ interferometer and a single column of programmable reflective phase shifters. We demonstrate the architecture by implementing a $3\times 3$ router in x-cut thin-film lithium niobate with a passive multimode interferometer and phase shifters based on single-sided photonic-crystal nanobeam cavities. Our programmable devices exhibit a $1.92$ GHz/V resonance tuning efficiency via the Pockels effect, a footprint of $100\,\mu\mathrm{m}^2$, sub-5-V drive voltage, and a 6.2 GHz electro-optic bandwidth. Through voltage-space characterization and physical modeling, we identify routing states with extinction ratios exceeding 11 dB at each output and demonstrate sequential routing at an equipment-limited speed of 10 MHz. Our results establish cavity-enhanced Pockels switching as a routing layer for classical and quantum computing interconnects across visible and near-infrared wavelengths.

summaries.en: The paper presents a compact reflective N-step photonic routing architecture using only O(N) single-port cavity-based electro-optic phase shifters (rather than O(N^2) for universal meshes), and demonstrates a 3×3 router in x-cut thin-film lithium niobate with low-voltage, fast, loss-compatible cavity-enhanced Pockels tuning achieving sub-5 V drive, 6.

title: Thermal-noise-limited stabilization of a self-injection-locked diode laser using a miniature Fabry-Perot cavity
abstract: We present an ultrastable laser system based on miniature core components: a self-injection-locked laser comprising a distributed-feedback laser diode and an integrated microring resonator, together with a 3-ml vacuum-gap Fabry-Perot cavity. By carefully addressing technical noise sources, in particular residual amplitude modulation, we demonstrate a thermal-noise-limited fractional frequency instability of $5\cdot10^{-15}$ for averaging times between 1 and 10 s, which is among the lowest reported for compact cavity-stabilized lasers. This performance is achieved with conventional multilayer mirrors and a moderate cavity finesse of $10^5$. Such stability of the output frequency, combined with the small size of the core components and a possibility to generate a Kerr frequency comb in the very same microring resonator, provides a path towards fully integrated photonic frequency references for transportable optical clocks and low-noise microwave synthesis.

summaries.en: The paper reports an ultrastable, compact laser system using a self-injection-locked DFB diode with an integrated microring resonator and a 3-ml vacuum-gap Fabry–Perot cavity, achieving thermal-noise-limited fractional frequency instability of 5×10⁻¹⁵ between 1 and 10 s by mitigating residual amplitude modulation while using standard mirrors and moderate finesse (10⁵).
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种超稳定、紧凑的激光系统，采用自注入锁定的DFB二极管并结合集成微环谐振器，同时用3 ml真空隙Fabry–Perot腔进行锁定，通过重点抑制剩余幅度调制等技术噪声，在标准多层镜与中等腔面精细度（10⁵）条件下实现了1至10 s时间尺度内热噪声极限的分数频率不稳定度5×10⁻¹⁵，并展望其用于可携式光钟与低噪声微波合成的全集成光学频率参考。

title: RADICAL: Reconfiguration-Aware Direct-Connect AI Cluster using Spatial-and-Wavelength Selective Switching
abstract: We present RADICAL, the silicon-photonic-enabled Reconfiguration-Aware Direct-Connect AI Cluster that integrates a custom spatial-and-wavelength selective switch (SWSS) with the Linux network stack. RADICAL deploys a packaged 4x4x4$\lambda$ microring-based SWSS into a four-GPU-server cluster using standard SFP28 optical transceivers, and a reconfiguration-aware host-networking interface to demonstrate a direct-connect reconfigurable optical fabric. The SWSS provides dynamic spatial and wavelength routing with 3.2-6.8 dB path loss, average wavelength and spatial crosstalk isolation exceeding 25 dB, and error-free 25 Gbps signal recovery across routing paths. At the system level, RADICAL validates reconfiguration-aware operation through continuous bulk data transfers totaling 6.4 TBytes over 10 minutes. We further demonstrate multitenant AI training across reconfigurable link topologies, including four ResNet-18 instances and six nanoGPT instances, with the latter sustained for more than five hours.

summaries.en: The paper presents RADICAL, a silicon-photonic direct-connect AI cluster that integrates a packaged 4x4x4 microring-based spatial-and-wavelength selective switch with the Linux network stack to enable reconfiguration-aware optical fabric routing with low path loss, high crosstalk isolation, and error-free 25 Gbps recovery, validated via bulk transfers and multi-tenant ResNet-18 and nanoGPT training over reconfigurable topologies.
summaries.zh: 论文提出RADICAL，这是一种硅光学直连AI集群方案，将封装的4x4x4微环空间-波长选择开关与Linux网络栈集成，实现具备重配置感知的光学织构路由；其具备3.

title: Cross-coupled photon avalanche drives room-temperature intrinsic optical bistability
abstract: Optically bistable materials promise technological advances in optical information processing, memristive devices, and multiparametric sensing. However, optical bistability is predominantly observed under cryogenic conditions or is governed by subtle thermo-optical nonlinearities. Here, we report on Ho3+-activated nanocrystals that exhibit cavity-free intrinsic optical bistability (IOB) at ambient conditions. Non-thermal IOB stems from a cross-coupled photon avalanche (XPA) mechanism enabled by a low-phonon-energy double-perovskite host, which reduces nonradiative losses and facilitates excited-state population via XPA, even when the pump intensity is below threshold. Time-resolved luminescence measurements support the proposed XPA, as evidenced by a double-rise profile consistent with two reservoir states interlocked in energy looping. IOB with high-contrast photoswitching (up to 46 dB) is observed at room temperature across multiple visible emission lines, enabling wavelength-division multiplexing and compatibility with common detectors. IOB is preserved across nano- to microscale crystals and different double-perovskite compositions, broadly enabling information photonics and advanced sensing.

summaries.en: The paper reports room-temperature, cavity-free intrinsic optical bistability in Ho3+-activated double-perovskite nanocrystals driven by a non-thermal cross-coupled photon avalanche mechanism that enables high-contrast photoswitching across multiple visible lines and is supported by time-resolved luminescence.
summaries.zh: 论文报道了Ho3+ 掺杂双钙钛矿纳米晶中在常温下出现无腔本征光学双稳态，其由非热的交叉耦合光子雪崩机制驱动，并以时间分辨发光结果得到支持，同时在多条可见光发射线上实现高对比度的光开关并在不同尺度与组成中保持稳定。

title: From Hollow Waveguides to Mie Voids: Low-Index Light Confinement
abstract: The confinement of light within optically thin media challenges the conventional view that optical localization requires high-index dielectric materials and total internal reflection. Over the past decades, a broad range of photonic phenomena has demonstrated that electromagnetic energy can also be guided and localized inside low-index regions or nanoscale void cavities. What first appears to be a curiosity is, in fact, highly relevant: The interaction between light and matter lies at the heart of much in optics and photonics. It enables sensing, nonlinear optical phenomena, and optical manipulation, yet it also inevitably introduces absorption, dissipation, and loss. Pushing localized, enhanced, or guided energy into a lower-index space thus offers entirely new possibilities for light-matter interaction and dispersion control. In this review, we discuss some of these counterintuitive structures, starting with light guidance within optically thin media, such as hollow-core photonic crystal fibers or antiresonant reflecting optical waveguides. We then discuss the optics of bubbles, that is, low-index inclusions in a higher-index surrounding, and ultimately arrive at the so-called Mie void resonators, optical resonators that support localized electromagnetic modes confined within a region of lower refractive index. All these systems demonstrate that there are (resonant) optics beyond simple total internal reflection. Absence can itself become a functional photonic degree of freedom, opening opportunities across sensing, quantum nanophotonics, metasurfaces, and programmable optical matter.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Applied Physics (physics.app-ph); Instrumentation and Detectors (physics.ins-det)

summaries.en: This review explains how light can be guided and localized in low-index hollow and void-like optical structures—including antiresonant hollow-core waveguides, bubble inclusions, and Mie-void resonators—showing that functional “resonant optics” can exist beyond total internal reflection and enabling new directions for sensing, nonlinear optics, and quantum nanophotonics.
summaries.zh: 该综述阐述了光如何在低折射率的空心与孔洞样光学结构中实现导引与局域，例如反谐振反射波导、气泡型折射率低的夹杂以及支持低折射率区域局域电磁模的米氏空腔谐振器，表明除了全内反射之外还存在可发挥功能的“共振光学”，并为传感、非线性光学与量子纳米光子学等方向开辟新机遇。

title: Stochastic Analysis of Laser Phase Noise in Photonics-Assisted Radio Frequency Beamforming
abstract: This paper develops a stochastic model for quantifying the impact of laser phase noise on photonics-assisted radio frequency (RF) beamforming. Unlike conventional deterministic models, the presented theoretical framework captures the statistical randomness associated with the RF array factor of beamforming networks driven by finite-linewidth lasers. Fourier-domain analysis reveals that laser phase noise reshapes the spatial coherence function of such beamforming networks, inducing coherent RF aperture shrinkage, beam-pattern distortion, and directivity degradation. The analysis highlights that beamforming network architectures employing nanosecond-scale optical differential delays can exhibit substantial performance degradation even when driven by commercially available narrow-linewidth (kHz-range) lasers. Furthermore, it is demonstrated that average RF power gain gets downscaled and fluctuations dominate in large-aperture beamforming networks due to phase noise, imposing an upper limit on the maximum achievable RF antenna array-size. The reported results highlight the quantitative performance and scalability limits imposed by laser phase noise in photonics-assisted RF beamforming, offering key design guidelines for implementing large-scale beamforming networks in next-generation wireless communications, sensing, radar, and radio astronomy applications.

summaries.en: The paper presents a stochastic Fourier-domain model showing that finite-linewidth laser phase noise reshapes spatial coherence in photonics-assisted RF beamforming, causing coherent aperture shrinkage, beam distortion, and reduced directivity and power gain that can sharply limit scalable large-aperture arrays even with kHz-linewidth lasers, thereby providing design guidance for next-generation wireless sensing and radar systems.
summaries.zh: 论文建立了随机傅里叶域模型，表明有限线宽激光的相位噪声会重塑光电辅助射频波束成形网络的空间相干性，进而引起相干孔径收缩、波束畸变与定向增益及平均功率增益下降；研究还指出，即使使用kHz量级线宽的商用激光，纳秒级光学差分延迟架构也可能出现显著性能退化，并对大孔径阵列的可扩展规模设定上限，为下一代无线通信、感知、雷达与射电天文应用提供设计指导。

title: Computational imaging through turbid, bubbly and flowing water near the telescope
abstract: Cameras in the surf zone or behind ship wakes look through turbid, bubbly, moving water close to the lens, yet restoration networks are usually scored only on displayed images. We introduce a measured dataset of a telescope viewing displayed images and physical objects through a 25~mm water layer 45~mm in front of its objective, under seven combinations of flow, bubbles and turbidity, with clear-water recordings as a second reference. Because the suspension scatters light far outside the 1.3\textdegree{} field of view, turbidity mainly removes contrast, 4.4- to 4.8-fold on a Siemens star. Restoring the mean of eight frames improves structural similarity (SSIM) by 0.032 over a single frame, and learned fusion of the frames adds little. One raw frame supports five-category recognition (96.8\%) as well as restored images. Adding synthetic training pairs leaves display-image scores unchanged but raises the correlation of a restored Siemens star with its clear-water recording from below 0.5 to above 0.9. These networks also improve ordinary underwater photographs without retraining, where training on measured pairs alone fails. Scoring against the digital source or a clear-water recording reverses the ranking of raw and restored images. These results support a simple pipeline: average the frames, classify raw frames directly, and restore with networks trained on measured and synthetic pairs.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

summaries.en: The paper presents a measured computational-imaging dataset for a telescope viewing displayed images and objects through turbid, bubbly, flowing water, showing that averaging eight frames modestly improves restoration quality, that raw frames enable high recognition, and that networks trained with measured (and synthetic) pairs greatly enhance correlation with clear-water recordings and generalize to real underwater photos when appropriate evaluation metrics are used.
summaries.zh: 论文构建了一个实测计算成像数据集，使望远镜通过浑浊、气泡和流动水层观察显示图像与物体，结果表明将八帧取平均能带来适度的复原质量提升，原始帧可实现很高的识别效果，而在结合实测与合成配对训练时，复原网络能显著提高与清水参考的相关性并在不再训练的情况下泛化到真实水下照片，且评估指标会反转原始与复原图像的排序。

title: Supercontinuum-driven broadband Fourier-transform photothermal microspectroscopy
abstract: Chemical characterization of microscopic samples often requires resolving multiple, widely separated vibrational absorption bands, including their positions and spectral shapes. Photothermal microspectroscopy provides a route to localized vibrational measurements by detecting absorption-induced thermal responses with a separate optical probe. However, rapid acquisition of broadband photothermal spectra remains challenging when spectral information is collected through sequential wavelength tuning. Here, we develop a supercontinuum (SC)-driven Fourier-transform photothermal (FT-PT) microspectroscopy platform that combines broadband near-infrared excitation with rapid-scan interferometric acquisition for localized vibrational measurements. In this approach, an interferometrically modulated SC pump induces wavelength-dependent photothermal responses in the sample, which are detected through a co-propagating visible probe beam and reconstructed by Fourier transformation. Using a 1.65-2.35 um spectral window, we demonstrate broadband photothermal spectra of aqueous samples with acquisition rates of approximately one spectrum per second. The system simultaneously resolves multiple molecular absorption features in a water-dimethyl sulfoxide mixture and reproduces the near-infrared absorption characteristics of liquid water with high spectral fidelity. Extending beyond homogeneous liquids, a dark-field detection configuration enables broadband photothermal spectroscopy of an individual 6 um polystyrene particle in an aqueous environment. This SC-based FT-PT microspectroscopy approach provides a rapid and broadband platform for localized vibrational characterization of liquid and microscopic samples, enabling chemical analysis with microscale spatial selectivity.

summaries.en: The paper presents a supercontinuum-driven Fourier-transform photothermal microspectroscopy platform that uses interferometric rapid-scan acquisition to rapidly reconstruct broadband near-infrared vibrational absorption spectra of microscopic samples with about one spectrum per second, achieving high-fidelity chemical characterization in both liquids and single micrometer-scale particles.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种由超连续谱（SC）驱动的傅里叶变换光热显微光谱平台，利用干涉仪快速扫描采集并重建宽带近红外振动吸收光谱，使液体及微观单颗粒的化学表征以约每秒一个光谱的速度实现且光谱保真度高。

title: Integrated elliptical III-V nanopillar arrays on silicon for dual photodetection and light emission
abstract: Next-generation on-chip photonic devices require compact, energy-efficient components integrating photodetection and light emission on silicon platforms. Achieving broadband photodetection combined with efficient emission in a single nanoscale device remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate elliptical nanopillar arrays monolithically integrated as III-V-on-Si templates, exhibiting broadband photoresponse across visible to near-infrared wavelengths, dynamic neuron-like graded responses under modulated light, and pronounced electroluminescence at around 865 nm under forward bias. The nanostructured elliptical geometry approach enhances optical absorption and carrier dynamics within an active area significantly smaller than commercial detectors, enabling responsivities up to 0.55 A/W at 830 nm in compact nanoarrays. This work advances the development of miniaturized active nanophotonic devices suitable for integrated sensing, emitting and communication circuits, and neuromorphic processing on silicon substrates.

title: Video-rate quantitative phase and polarimetric imaging (QP2I) for label-free imaging of contracting muscle cells
abstract: Quantitative phase imaging (QPI) has become a standard approach for label-free microscopy of transparent specimens, mapping the optical path length. However, the isotropic phase is blind to the molecular order underlying optical anisotropy. Implementations that also add quantitative contrast to birefringence, rely on multi-frame illumination or polarization-state scanning, or on dedicated interferometric hardware, that trade away acquisition speed or the simplicity of a standard microscope. We present Quantitative Phase and Polarimetric Imaging (QP2I), a computational imaging framework that converts a standard differential interference contrast (DIC) microscope with a polarization camera into a single-shot, video-rate, dual-contrast imaging system. We developed a new globally regularized phase reconstruction that eliminates artifacts of prior DIC-to-QPI approaches, providing quantitative phase information and used per-pixel Stokes-based reconstruction to obtain quantitative anisotropic retardance. We validate the approach across simulations, static reference targets, fixed muscle tissue and living dynamically moving cells. Thereby, QP2I enables to study contractile dynamics in live cardiomyocytes all-optically and label-free. It provides both structural and functional readouts at frame rates that are sufficient to temporally resolve fast cardiomyocyte contractions. While conventional fluorescent labels bleach out over time, perturb physiology, and preclude long-term monitoring, QP2I provides similar established structural readouts, such as frame-by-frame sarcomere length, as well as previously inaccessible measurements, like quantitative analysis of retardance changes during muscle contraction, as a direct optical signature of muscle photoelasticity. QP2I thus enables long-term, label-free interrogation of dynamic cellular processes at quantitative contrast.

summaries.en: The paper presents QP2I, a computational single-shot framework that upgrades a standard DIC microscope with a polarization camera to provide video-rate quantitative phase and polarimetric (anisotropic retardance) imaging for label-free monitoring of contracting muscle cells, including dynamically tracking sarcomere length and measuring retardance changes linked to muscle photoelasticity.
summaries.zh: 本文提出QP2I，一种将普通DIC显微镜与偏振相机结合的计算成像框架，可实现单次成像、视频速率的定量相位与偏振（各向异性延迟度）双重对比，用于无标记监测收缩肌肉细胞；通过追踪逐帧的肌节长度并量化与肌肉光弹性相关的延迟变化。

title: The Entire Quantum Computer on a Classical Leash
abstract: We show that a classical client with no quantum hardware can use a single untrusted and potentially malicious quantum server as if it were its own trusted quantum computer. Through the server, the client can privately choose and run quantum computations, prepare quantum states, and process quantum states supplied by other parties. It can also keep quantum memory on the server, hidden from the server itself, and use that memory in later computations so its quantum state persists across rounds of interaction. Together, these capabilities let a purely classical party act as a quantum party in a variety of interactive protocols. We expect this virtual quantum computer to be a broadly useful tool. As immediate applications, we resolve two known open problems: (1) classical verification of quantum sampling with negligible computational soundness error, and (2) remote state preparation of arbitrary efficiently preparable quantum states. Underlying all of these results is a general-purpose, maliciously secure two-party computation protocol between a classical client and a quantum server, which we construct assuming only the post-quantum hardness of learning with errors.

summaries.en: The paper shows how a fully classical client can securely and privately delegate quantum computations to an untrusted, potentially malicious quantum server—acting as if it had its own quantum computer, including hidden persistent quantum memory—using a maliciously secure two-party computation protocol based only on the post-quantum hardness of Learning With Errors, and it applies this framework to solve problems on classical verification of quantum sampling and remote state preparation with negligible error.
summaries.zh: 本文证明：一个完全没有量子硬件的经典客户端，可以像拥有自家量子计算机一样，安全且私密地把量子计算委托给单个不可信且可能恶意的量子服务器，甚至可在服务器上保持对服务器不可见的持久量子记忆并跨轮次继续使用该量子态，并基于仅需后量子“学习带误差(LWE)”困难性的恶意安全两方计算协议实现这些能力，且立即应用于解决量子采样的经典验证以及任意高效可制备量子态的远程制备等公开问题。

title: Optimal Control of a Fluxonium Circuit with the Q-PRONTO Numerical Method
abstract: Optimizing the control of large quantum systems is a resource-intensive task, where the convergence rate of the underlying iterative schemes is crucial. The recently developed Quantum Projection Operator-Based Newton Method for Trajectory Optimization (Q-PRONTO) offers a unique quadratic convergence for controlling quantum states, while most model-based solvers guarantee only an approximately linear convergence rate. As a proof of concept, here, we design and benchmark single-qubit gates optimized by Q-PRONTO based on the circuit Hamiltonian of a fluxonium superconducting qubit. To ensure that we can apply a long string of arbitrary pulses to the circuit, we modify the firmware associated with the Quantum Instrumentation Control Kit (QICK) by altering its memory allocation. We characterize the performance of the optimal solutions using standard randomized benchmarking and achieve a total error per gate of $6.6\times10^{-4}$.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates and benchmarks Q-PRONTO for optimizing fluxonium superconducting qubit single-qubit gates, achieving quadratic convergence in the trajectory optimization framework and attaining a measured total gate error of 6.
summaries.zh: 本文通过在通量铌（fluxonium）超导量子比特的电路哈密顿量上进行单比特门优化，展示并基准测试了Q-PRONTO方法：其轨迹优化具备二次收敛优势，并在为长任意脉冲序列改造QICK固件内存分配后，结合随机基准测试表征性能，最终实现单门总误差6.

title: Graphical Rigidity of Continuous Variable Graph States under Gaussian Local Transformations
abstract: Multimode entangled pure Gaussian states are an essential resource for continuous variable (CV) quantum information processing. Menicucci et al. [2011] have shown how to describe them as graphs with complex adjacency matrices. Among such complex graph states (CGSs), quantum optics experimental setups straightforwardly display correlations described by purely imaginary graph states (iRGSs) whereas theoretical literature favors off-diagonal real graph state (RGS) descriptions, which actually reflect the entanglement structure in the infinite squeezing limit [Gonzalez-Arciniegas et al. 2021]. We study them beyond this ideal case, thus establishing in the finite squeezing regime an equivalence criterion for the generic case of CGSs through a graph propagating set of conditions which either finds a Gaussian Local Unitary (GLU) converting one state to another or gives a proof of impossibility if such a GLU does not exist. In the experimentally relevant case of the conversion between iRGSs and RGSs, the set of conditions results in simple relations between the topologies of the equivalent real and imaginary graphs. Finally, we show that the canonical forms of iRGSs and RGSs imply that the topology of the CV real and imaginary graph states are too rigid to admit any exact qumode local-addition analogue to the qubit complementation or qudit local-addition, thus demonstrating the non-existence of any exact qumode local-addition for these states. We however define an approximate one when the squeezing is strong enough.

summaries.en: The paper develops finite-squeezing criteria for when continuous-variable complex Gaussian graph states are interconvertible under Gaussian local unitaries, applies them to relate imaginary and real graph topologies between iRGSs and RGSs, and uses canonical forms to show that exact qumode local-addition analogues (like qubit/qudit complementation) do not exist for these states, while constructing an approximate version for sufficiently strong squeezing.
summaries.zh: 本文在有限压缩情形下建立判定连续变量复高斯图态在高斯局域幺正作用下是否可相互转化的等价准则，进而用于分析iRGS与RGS之间的实/虚图拓扑关系，并借助规范形式证明这些态不存在精确的类比“qumode局域加法”（如量子比特/高维比特的complementation）操作，而在压缩足够强时给出其近似实现。

title: Demonstrating RFSoC-based Control of a Fully Connected Exchange-Only Qubit
abstract: Semiconductor triple-quantum dots (TQDs) are a promising platform for scalable quantum information processing, but the community has so far lacked access to affordable and flexible high-speed control electronics. SpinQICK, an open-source spin qubit-control package built on the Xilinx Radio Frequency System-on-Chip (RFSoC), directly addresses this gap by leveraging the high sampling-rate signal generation and advanced digital signal processing (DSP) capabilities of the Quantum Instrumentation Control Kit (QICK) to enable precise time-domain voltage control and readout of semiconductor spin qubits. In this paper, we use spinQICK to demonstrate coherent control, state preparation, and readout of a fully connected triangular exchange-only device. We also introduce and experimentally verify a novel dynamical decoupling (DD) sequence enabled by the triangular TQD and leverage its unique decoupling properties to characterize electrical noise. These results establish spinQICK as a low-cost, flexible platform for semiconductor spin qubit control and provide a pathway for hardware optimization through qubit-level noise diagnostics.

summaries.en: The paper presents SpinQICK, an open-source RFSoC-based control package that uses high-speed signal generation and DSP to coherently control, prepare, and read out a fully connected triangular exchange-only triple-quantum-dot qubit, including an experimentally verified triangular-TQD dynamical decoupling sequence for electrical-noise characterization.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了基于Xilinx RFSoC 的开源自旋量子比特控制包 SpinQICK，利用高速信号生成与数字信号处理实现对全连接三角形三量子点交换型量子比特的相干控制、态制备与读出，并实验验证了由三角形TQD支持的新型动态解耦序列以刻画电学噪声，从而证明其作为低成本、灵活的自旋量子比特控制平台并为基于噪声诊断的硬件优化提供路径。

title: Robustness of Quantum Correlations and Controlled Teleportation Fidelity under Noisy Channels
abstract: In distributed quantum computing, quantum networks provide a potential infrastructure for long-range quantum information processing. Controlled quantum teleportation (CQT) is a key practically relevant protocol that can connect two parties on a network and enables a third party, the controller to allow or abort the secure teleportation of an arbitrary single-qubit state between the two parties. We investigate the robustness of a three-qubit GHZ resource under bit-flip, phase-flip, depolarizing, and amplitude-damping noise. Using the Kraus-operator formalism, we characterize the noisy resource through multipartite quantum discord, genuine multipartite concurrence (GMC), localizable entanglement (LE), and CQT fidelity. We also outline a proof-of-concept photonic implementation for preparing the three-qubit GHZ resource and realizing the CQT protocol, which could enable experimental investigation of the effects of noise. Our results show that bit-flip and amplitude-damping noise generally preserve useful mutipartite quantum correlations over broader noise parameter ranges. Interestingly, multipartite discord exhibits freezing under bit-flip noise over a finite parameter regime. Moreover, discord can persist beyond the sudden death of genuine multipartite entanglement, revealing the distinct robustness of nonclassical correlations. We further demonstrate that CQT fidelity which characterizes the performance of CQT can exceed the classical threshold even after GMC vanishes, while LE more closely reflects the operational usefulness of the noisy resource. These findings highlight the complementary roles of quantum correlations and entanglement in assessing the resilience of GHZ-based protocols.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes how a three-qubit GHZ resource used for controlled quantum teleportation performs under bit-flip, phase-flip, depolarizing, and amplitude-damping noise, using Kraus-operator modeling to track quantum discord, genuine multipartite concurrence, localizable entanglement, and teleportation fidelity and proposes a photonic proof-of-concept implementation, finding that certain correlations (notably discord) can freeze or persist beyond entanglement sudden death and that CQT fidelity can remain above the classical limit even after GMC vanishes.
summaries.zh: 论文通过Kraus算子方法研究三比特GHZ资源在比特翻转、相位翻转、退极化和振幅阻尼噪声下用于受控量子隐形传态的鲁棒性，评估多方量子迟豫、真正多方纠缠(GMC)、局域可定位纠缠(LE)及隐形传态保真度，并提出光子层面的原型实现，结果表明部分非经典相关（如迟豫）可在比特翻转下冻结或在真正多方纠缠发生突然死亡后仍能存在，同时受控隐形传态保真度可在GMC消失后仍超过经典阈值，凸显纠缠与量子相关在评估GHZ协议抗噪性中的互补作用。

title: Real-space construction and selection rules of center-of-mass momentum eigenstates in two-dimensional many-body lattices
abstract: We present a comprehensive framework for the real-space construction of center-of-mass (c.m.) momentum eigenstates in two-dimensional (2D) quantum many-body systems. Unlike standard momentum-space approaches, our real-space formalism explicitly captures the non-uniformity of cyclic subspace dimensions, which are fundamentally governed by the spatial symmetries of the many-body configurations and particle statistics. We demonstrate that performing 2D real-space translations on multi-particle states naturally induces non-trivial translation phase factors associated with the characters of these stabilizer subgroups, leading to a renormalization of permissible momentum values. Notably, we identify an anomalous cross-dimensional momentum coupling in highly symmetric particle distributions, where the permissible momentum values in one direction are strictly constrained by those in the perpendicular direction. We emphasize the algorithmic necessity of this coupling, as neglecting it leads to missing or duplicated basis states in numerical implementations. Concrete examples are provided to demonstrate the practical implementation and physical consequences of this framework.

summaries.en: The paper develops a real-space method to construct center-of-mass momentum eigenstates in 2D many-body lattices, revealing symmetry- and statistics-dependent cyclic-subspace non-uniformity, induced phase factors from stabilizer-group characters that renormalize allowed momenta, and an anomalous cross-dimensional momentum coupling in highly symmetric cases that is algorithmically essential to avoid missing or duplicating basis states, with concrete examples and physical implications provided.

title: Quantum Cryptomania with Classical Communication without One-Way Functions
abstract: In classical cryptography, one-way functions are necessary for most of cryptography. In the quantum world, however, Kretschmer at {TQC'21} and subsequent works have demonstrated that quantum versions of various primitives in minicrypt, such as signatures and private-key encryption, do not require quantum-computable one-way functions (\textsf{qOWF}s). However, the question of the necessity of \textsf{qOWF}s for primitives in Cryptomania like public-key encryption with classical public keys and ciphertexts (\textsf{qPKE}) has remained open. We provide a comprehensive picture of the relationship between \textsf{qPKE} and \textsf{qOWF}. First, our main result is a black-box separation between \textsf{qOWF}s and \textsf{qPKE}. In particular, we show that relative to a unitary, real, and self-inverse oracle, there exists a \textsf{qPKE} scheme (with classical keys and ciphertexts), but \textsf{qOWF}s do not exist. Further, our oracles admit a point-function obfuscation construction, thus ruling out black-box construction of \textsf{qOWF} from point function obfuscations. On the positive side, we construct \textsf{qPKE} from quantum indistinguishability obfuscation for quantum circuits with classical obfuscated descriptions and efficiently verifiable one-way puzzles, which is known to be a potentially weaker assumption than \textsf{qOWF}s, due to an existing black-box separation. Our construction is the quantum analog of the classical construction of \textsf{PKE} from one-way functions and indistinguishability obfuscation in the quantum computation with classical communication (QCCC) setting.

summaries.en: The paper gives a black-box separation showing that quantum one-way functions may be impossible while quantum public-key encryption with classical keys/ciphertexts (qPKE) can exist, and it also presents a positive construction of qPKE from quantum indistinguishability obfuscation with efficiently verifiable one-way puzzles under classical-communication quantum computation settings.
summaries.zh: 论文通过黑盒分离结果表明：量子单向函数（qOWF）可能不存在而带有经典密钥与密文的量子公钥加密（qPKE）仍可能存在，并在量子计算的经典通信（QCCC）框架下给出基于量子不可区分性混淆与可高效验证的单向难题构造qPKE的正向结果。

title: Photon-Number Discrimination from Increasing Time-of-Arrival Separation in Wide Superconducting Microstrip Single-Photon Detectors
abstract: Measurements of photon-number-dependent time-of-arrival (TOA) distributions in wide NbN superconducting microstrip single-photon detectors (SMSPDs) are presented. Two \SI{10}{\um}-long devices with widths of \SI{3.2}{\um} and \SI{6.4}{\um} are characterized under pulsed \SI{515}{nm} excitation. The TOA histograms are described by sums of exponentially modified Gaussian (EMG) components, with the wider device exhibiting components assigned to photon numbers up to \(n=8\). Adjacent TOA peaks become more distinguishable relative to their widths at higher photon number, in contrast to the compression of neighboring photon-number timing shifts observed in conventional narrow-wire SNSPDs. For the components assigned to \(n=7\) and \(n=8\), the FWHM-normalized peak separation is \(2.15\), and the fitted EMG distributions yield an equal-prior pairwise TOA-assignment fidelity of \(99.6\%\). The EMG exponential-tail parameter \(\tau_n\) decreases strongly with photon number, while the Gaussian-location parameter \(\mu_n\) continues to shift between neighboring components. A phenomenological model motivated by absorption-site-dependent vortex processes and collective current redistribution captures these timing trends. These results support wide SMSPDs as a platform for TOA-based photon-number discrimination at high photon number, relevant to multiphoton-state characterization and photonic quantum information processing. The same geometry also provides a setting to examine how the spatial distribution of photon absorption affects vortex-assisted detection.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; High Energy Physics - Experiment (hep-ex); Applied Physics (physics.app-ph)

summaries.en: The paper reports photon-number-dependent time-of-arrival histograms measured from wide NbN superconducting microstrip single-photon detectors, showing that increasing time-of-arrival separation with photon number enables photon-number discrimination up to n=8 with 99.
summaries.zh: 论文测量了宽NbN超导微带单光子探测器中的光子数依赖到达时间（TOA）分布，发现随光子数增大相邻到达时间峰相对展宽更易区分，从而可区分到n=8，且n=7与n=8分量的成对指派保真度达到99.

title: High Resolution Hyperspectral Quantum Infrared Imaging with Undetected Photons
abstract: Quantum sensing in the infrared regime often demands the use of expensive and cryogenically operated detectors. Nonlinear interferometry has paved the way for information transfer from the infrared to the near--infrared or visible regime in various quantum technologies. A particularly interesting application of these interferometers involves spectrally--resolved quantum imaging using undetected photons, enabled by the use of temperature--tunable parametric amplifiers. In this work, we demonstrate spectrally resolved transmission imaging with undetected photons around 1550 nm using a spontaneous parametric down conversion based folded nonlinear interferometric scheme, registering the attenuation of a zebrafish larva as a biological feasibility test. We characterize and calibrate the interferometer, having achieved spectrally resolved interference fringes with a maximum baseline visibility of $\sim 74\%$ in the near--infrared regime. Phase--stepped readout of a grating spectrometer gives a resolving power of $\sim1460$ (from the spectrometer's point spread function) at 1550 nm, and $\sim 730$ from the coherence length, the finest reported for imaging with undetected photons, over an instantaneous spectral window of $\approx 51$ cm$^{-1}$.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates spectrally resolved quantum infrared transmission imaging using undetected photons at ~1550 nm via a folded nonlinear interferometer with temperature-tunable parametric amplifiers, validating the method by imaging a zebrafish larva and achieving calibrated interference fringes with up to ~74% visibility and high spectral resolving power (~1460 from the spectrometer PSF and ~730 from coherence length) over an instantaneous window of ~51 cm⁻¹.
summaries.zh: 论文通过带温度可调参量放大器的折叠非线性干涉仪实现约1550 nm处基于“未探测光子”的红外传输的光谱分辨量子成像，并以斑马鱼幼体的衰减成像验证可行性，同时校准并获得最高约74%的近红外谱分辨干涉条纹可见度；利用阶梯相位读出获得约1460（由光谱仪PSF）与约730（由相干长度）量级的谱分辨率，且在约51 cm⁻¹的瞬时光谱窗口内达到成像。

title: Fundamental bound on Wigner negativity generation from environmental collisions
abstract: Beyond quadratic potentials, classical evolution laws are typically thought to arise from quantum theory as an approximate description. Here we show that classical evolution laws can emerge exactly, provided the environment interacts with the system via collisions. We use this to derive an inequality that lower bounds the distribution of environmental momentum kicks by the absolute value of the Fourier transform of the potential. We show that violating this inequality is necessary and sufficient for a non-quadratic potential to generate negativity from the set of positive Wigner functions. A simple consequence of this is a lower bound on the heating rate for a quantum system to evolve effectively classically. We illustrate our results using the theory of a levitated nanoparticle subject to photon recoil and background gas collisions. We derive the strength of external potential needed to generate Wigner negative states in an optical tweezer and propose an experimental test of whether a nanoparticle in an optical lattice is operating in a non-classical regime.

summaries.en: The paper proves that with environmental collisions, classical equations can emerge exactly from quantum dynamics and derives a lower-bound inequality on momentum-kick statistics tied to the Fourier transform of the potential, showing that violating this condition is equivalent to non-quadratic potentials generating Wigner-function negativity and implying bounds on heating rates, illustrated for levitated nanoparticles with photon recoil and gas collisions along with an experimentally testable criterion for non-classical operation in optical lattices.
summaries.zh: 论文证明在环境通过碰撞与系统相互作用时，经典演化方程可以与量子动力学完全一致地精确产生，并推导出一个将环境动量冲击分布下界与势能傅里叶变换联系起来的不等式，指出只有当该条件被违反时非二次势才能生成Wigner函数的负性且该条件在逻辑上是充要的；文中进一步给出有效经典演化所需的最低加热率估计，并以受光子反冲与背景气体碰撞影响的悬浮纳米颗粒为例，推算光学镊子中产生Wigner负态所需的外势强度，并提出检验光学晶格中颗粒是否处于非经典工作区的实验方案。

title: Entangled logical qubits on a superconducting quantum processor
abstract: We demonstrate high-fidelity logical qubit operations using \texttt{ibm\_phoenix}, a square-lattice array of 120 coupled superconducting qubits that are capable of fast reset. Using strategies to exclude underperforming components together with noise informed decoding, we routinely produce surface codes at distance-3 and distance-5 with logical error per round below 1\%. We demonstrate entanglement between two logical qubits, where logical Bell-state fidelities above 93\% are observed for entanglement created via lattice surgery. With three logical qubits and lattice surgery, we perform logical teleportation of a range of states and gates, observing fidelities in the range 78\% - 93\%. Using reset to reduce qubit leakage, we show that repeated rounds of stabilizer measurements continue to exhibit improvements in a stability experiment up to $\sim 2\cdot 10^{-7}$ over 170 measurement rounds.

summaries.en: The paper reports high-fidelity, fast-reset logical-qubit operations on IBM’s ibm_phoenix superconducting processor, achieving surface codes of distances 3 and 5 with <1% logical error per round, entangling two logical qubits with >93% Bell-state fidelity, and using three logical qubits for lattice-surgery-based logical teleportation of states and gates with 78–93% fidelities, while stabilizer-measurement performance improves through repeated rounds down to ~2×10^-7 over 170 rounds via leakage-reducing reset.
summaries.zh: 论文在IBM的ibm_phoenix超导量子处理器上实现了高保真、快复位的逻辑比特操作，成功获得距离3和5的表面码且每轮逻辑误差<1%，通过晶格手术实现两逻辑比特纠缠并观察到>93%的逻辑贝尔态保真度，并用三个逻辑比特结合晶格手术完成态与门的逻辑传送（保真度78–93%），同时借助减少泄漏的复位在170轮稳定性测量中通过重复稳定器测量将性能改进到约2×10^-7。

title: Quantum theory of laser noise in coherent-scattering levitated optomechanics
abstract: State purity is a key resource for experimental tests of quantum mechanics with massive objects. Cavity cooling of a levitated nanoparticle via coherent scattering stands out as a strategy to prepare highly pure states of its roto-translational motion. In several cases, though, the performance of cooling by coherent scattering is limited by the classical fluctuations of the laser field. Here we present a quantum theory of coherent-scattering experiments which includes the effect of the laser amplitude and phase noise. We derive a master equation for the noise-averaged particle's dynamics, valid for both center-of-mass and rotational degrees of freedom, and quantify the cooling performance for different levels of noise in state-of-the-art experiments. We compute approximate analytical expressions for the laser-noise-induced heating rates and excess phonon number in both regimes of weak and strong optomechanical coupling. Moreover, our model can be applied to laser noise processes with generic power spectral densities and finite correlation times. This work offers a toolbox to quantify and optimize the state purity in coherent-scattering experiments, and opens new avenues towards the preparation of quantum states with levitated systems.

summaries.en: The paper develops a quantum-theory master equation for coherent-scattering cavity cooling of a levitated nanoparticle that accounts for laser amplitude and phase noise, deriving analytical heating and excess-phonon results across weak and strong optomechanical coupling and enabling optimization of state purity for both translational and rotational motions under general noise spectra.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一套量子理论主方程来描述利用相干散射对悬浮纳米颗粒进行腔冷却时激光幅度与相位噪声的影响，推导了在弱与强光机械耦合两种极限下由噪声引起的加热率与额外声子数的近似解析结果，并可用于在平动与转动自由度下对态纯度进行量化与优化，且适用于具有一般功率谱密度和有限相关时间的噪声过程。

title: LYNX - A trapped-ion quantum information processor
abstract: We introduce LYNX, a quantum information processor based on trapped $^{40}$Ca$^+$ ions. It utilizes up to 31 qubits with all-to-all connectivity. We characterize the system performance using rigorous benchmarks, such as randomized benchmarking (RB), GHZ state fidelity estimates, and quantum volume (QV) tests. The LYNX processor shows average 1-qubit gate errors of $8(5)\times 10^{-5}$ tested via standard RB in a 24-qubit register. An average 2-qubit gate error in a 24-qubit register of $2.84(8)\times 10^{-3}$ is demonstrated using interleaved RB. Furthermore, the device passes QV tests using up to 15 qubits which corresponds to a quantum volume of QV$=2^{15}$.

summaries.en: The paper presents LYNX, a trapped-40Ca+ trapped-ion quantum information processor with up to 31 all-to-all connected qubits, reporting rigorous benchmarks including randomized benchmarking, GHZ fidelity estimates, and quantum volume tests with measured average 1-qubit gate errors of 8(5)×10^-5, average 2-qubit gate errors of 2.
summaries.zh: 论文介绍了基于40Ca+离子的LYNX囚禁离子量子信息处理器，最多提供31个全连接的量子比特，并通过随机基准（RB）、GHZ态保真度评估和量子体积（QV）测试等严格基准进行表征：在24比特寄存器上测得平均1比特门误差为8(5)×10^-5、在同样规模上用交织RB测得平均2比特门误差为2.

title: Photon-Pair Advantage for Dissipative Parameter Estimation in Whispering-Gallery-Mode Interferometers
abstract: We study the estimation of detuning and intrinsic loss in a lossy whispering-gallery-mode (WGM) resonator located in a balanced Mach--Zehnder interferometer. We use indistinguishable photon pairs and coherent-state probes. We show that using indistinguishable photon pairs can provide higher Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) of dissipative parameters, such as intrinsic loss, at resonance away from critical coupling. Taking into account all photon-loss outcomes, we obtain analytical QFI expressions and compare photon-pair and coherent-state probe results when they have the same mean photon number. For estimating the round-trip amplitude transmission at resonance and away from critical coupling, the photon-pair probe gives a higher QFI than the coherent-state probe, and photon-number-resolved detection saturates this QFI. This advantage is due to the photon-loss statistics and it is still accessible for a typical overcoupled condition after averaging over fluctuations of the unresolved detuning. We identify the limits of this advantage: phase doubling does not improve resonant detuning estimation, and coincidence-only detection is inefficient close to a zero transmission. These results identify the cases in which photon pairs can be useful for absorption and pump--probe WGM sensing.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes dissipative parameter estimation (detuning and intrinsic loss) for a lossy whispering-gallery-mode resonator in a Mach–Zehnder interferometer, showing that indistinguishable photon pairs yield higher quantum Fisher information for loss parameters than coherent-state probes at the same mean photon number (with photon-number-resolved detection reaching saturation) except for cases like resonant detuning where phase doubling gives no benefit and coincidence-only detection becomes inefficient near zero transmission.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了置于马赫-曾德尔干涉仪中的有损微球/环形谐振器（WGM）对解谐与本征损耗等耗散参数的估计，并表明在相同平均光子数下，理想不可区分的光子对在谐振且远离临界耦合时可比相干态探测提供更高的量子费舍尔信息（且光子数分辨探测能达到该QFI饱和），其优势来源于光子损失统计；但在谐振解谐估计中相位倍增不带来改进，且在透射接近零时仅做符合计数的探测效率较低，因此明确了光子对在吸收与泵-探测WGM传感中的适用边界。

title: Classical Pre-Training of Large Shallow Parametrized Quantum Circuits through Pauli Propagation and deployment on Quantum Hardware
abstract: Scaling parametrized quantum circuits to a larger number of qubits is a central challenge in Quantum Machine Learning: gradient estimation via the parameter-shift rule quickly becomes prohibitively expensive, while gradient-free optimizers offer limited convergence guarantees. We apply the Pauli propagation framework to a broad class of Quantum Machine Learning problems in which the loss is expressed as a function of expectation values of the circuit's observables, while keeping the relevant quantity of interest, such as the quantum state or its samples, classically intractable to compute. By propagating the observables backward through the circuit, we obtain an explicit parametric expression for the loss that can be minimized entirely on classical hardware. We also present complementary strategies to make propagation tractable at large scale, including weight-based and degree-based truncations and pruning heuristics. We demonstrate the approach on two benchmarks run on 64-qubit circuits: Variational Quantum Eigensolver on a two-dimensional Ising model, and training of a discrete-type generative model for binary images. In both cases, the classically pre-trained parameters are deployed on the IBM quantum processor ibm_berlin. For generative learning, we additionally show that the circuits considered here require substantially fewer parametrized gates than IQP-style ansätze, reducing transpilation overhead and making deployment on current quantum hardware feasible.

summaries.en: The paper uses Pauli propagation to derive a classically optimizable parametric loss for large shallow parametrized quantum circuits, adding truncation and pruning methods to scale the propagation, and demonstrates classically pre-trained parameters on 64-qubit benchmarks that are then deployed on IBM hardware (ibm_berlin) for variational eigensolving and discrete generative modeling with reduced circuit complexity and transpilation overhead.
summaries.zh: 论文通过Pauli传播为大规模浅层参数化量子电路推导出可在经典硬件上完全最小化的显式参数化损失，并提出截断与剪枝策略以提升其可扩展性；在64量子比特基准任务（变分量子特征求解与离散生成建模）上验证经典预训练参数后部署到IBM处理器ibm_berlin，同时表明所用电路比IQP型方法参数门显著更少，从而降低移植开销并使当前量子硬件部署可行。

title: A note on the monotonicity of observational ergotropic advantage
abstract: Very recently, Mahanti et al. ( arXiv:2609.18735 ) introduced the observational ergotropic advantage, which gives the maximum value of extra work that a measurement can obtain with respect to all incoherent measurements. However, the above quantity does not show monotonic behaviour under the resource theory of measurement coherence. So, the search for a resource theory in which it is a monotone was open. We derive the monotonicity of this quantity using energy-preserving channels and passive resets as free operations and energy-incoherent measurements as free objects. We show the monotonicity property of the measure as a necessary criterion of measurement transformation, but it turns out not to be a sufficient condition. It is further established that the measure is not convex. A short analysis of bounds and tightness of the measure using a degenerate Hamiltonian is also given.

summaries.en: The paper proves that the observational ergotropic advantage can be made monotonic under a resource theory where energy-preserving channels and passive resets are free operations and energy-incoherent measurements are free objects, while showing it is a necessary but not sufficient condition for measurement transformability, is non-convex, and provides bounds and tightness results using a degenerate Hamiltonian.
summaries.zh: 本文在定义能量守恒通道与被动复位为自由操作、能量非相干测量为自由对象的资源理论框架下，证明了观察性“返工能力优势”（observational ergotropic advantage）的单调性，并指出该指标对测量可转化性是必要条件但并非充分条件，同时给出其非凸性以及在简并哈密顿量下的界与紧性分析。

title: Trace-distance characterization of recurrent pairwise synchronization in cavity-coupled superconducting qubits
abstract: We theoretically investigate recurrent pairwise synchronization in three super?conducting qubits coupled to a common single-mode microwave cavity. The qubits interact indirectly through the cavity field and are driven by a coher?ent microwave field. We obtain the coherent dynamics in the dressed-state basis and quantify pairwise synchronization by the trace distance between reduced single-qubit density matrices. The trace-distance dynamics exhibit oscillatory wave-packet structures, with low-trace-distance regions identifying finite syn?chronization windows. An envelope-threshold procedure is introduced to extract the representative duration of these windows. By varying the middle-qubit coupling strength and the relative coupling ratio of the outer qubits, we con?struct a parameter-dependent map of the synchronization-window duration. The duration decreases rapidly with increasing relative outer-qubit coupling and becomes weakly dependent on the middle-qubit coupling in the stronger-coupling regime. These results provide a reduced-state-based characterization of coherent collective dynamics in multiqubit circuit-QED systems.

summaries.en: The paper develops a dressed-state theoretical model for three cavity-coupled superconducting qubits and characterizes recurrent pairwise synchronization by tracking trace-distance oscillations between reduced single-qubit density matrices, extracting synchronization-window durations via an envelope-threshold method and mapping how these durations depend on qubit coupling ratios.
summaries.zh: 本文建立三比特耦合单模腔场的微波系统的本征（dress）态理论模型，并用单量子比特约化密度矩阵之间的迹距离振荡来刻画成对的循环同步，通过包络阈值法提取同步窗口持续时间，同时绘制其随中间比特耦合强度与外侧比特相对耦合比变化的参数图景。

title: Quantum Machine Learning in Medical Imaging: A Primer for Radiologists
abstract: Deep learning has transformed radiology, but the computational cost of training and deploying modern models is outpacing what classical hardware can support. Quantum computing has been proposed as one response to this bottleneck: an n-qubit system can represent $2^n$ states simultaneously, although practical speedups require efficient algorithms, data encoding, and measurement strategies rather than superposition alone. This review introduces radiologists to five core quantum concepts, qubits, superposition, entanglement, quantum gates, and quantum circuits, and to the superconducting, trapped-ion, and photonic hardware platforms that define the current noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era. We then summarize the quantum machine learning architectures most often applied to medical imaging (quantum support vector machines, quantum neural networks, variational quantum circuits, and quantum convolutional neural networks) and quantum image representations such as the flexible representation of quantum images (FRQI) and the novel enhanced quantum representation (NEQR). Reported applications include brain tumor classification and segmentation on MRI, pneumonia detection on chest radiographs, skin and breast lesion classification, CT and PET reconstruction, and ultrasound denoising. Nearly all published systems are hybrid quantum-classical pipelines evaluated on small, downsampled benchmark datasets or simulators, and clinical deployment is not yet feasible. We conclude with current limitations and translational priorities for radiology.

summaries.en: The paper reviews quantum computing fundamentals and quantum machine learning methods for medical imaging—covering qubits, superposition, entanglement, gates, circuits, relevant NISQ hardware, and approaches like quantum SVMs, quantum neural networks, variational circuits, and quantum CNNs—along with quantum image encodings (FRQI, NEQR), reporting mostly hybrid quantum-classical experiments on small benchmark data or simulators and concluding that clinical deployment remains infeasible with key limitations to be addressed.
summaries.zh: 本文面向放射科医生综述量子计算基础与用于医学影像的量子机器学习方法，涵盖比特、叠加、纠缠、量子门与量子电路、当前NISQ时代的相关硬件平台，以及量子支持向量机、量子神经网络、变分量子电路和量子卷积神经网络等架构与量子图像表示（FRQI、NEQR），并总结现有多数研究采用混合量子-经典流程、在小规模基准数据或仿真器上评估，最终指出临床落地仍不可行且需明确转换优先事项与关键限制。

title: Exploiting the Weyl-Chamber Structure for Hardware-Aware Quantum Circuit Compression
abstract: Quantum circuit compression based on tensor networks enables long-time simulation of quantum many-body dynamics on near-term hardware. While Riemannian optimization has been successfully employed for this purpose, it typically optimizes over the manifold of generic two-qubit unitaries. Consequently, the resulting gates must still be synthesized into the hardware's native gate set via KAK decomposition, an overhead that partially negates the original compression gain. We show that Riemannian-optimized gates already exhibit a predictable Weyl structure: near-$R_{ZZ}$ for the Ising model and near-fSim for the Heisenberg XXZ model. Building on this insight, we investigate whether parameterized optimization directly over the native gate set can offer a beneficial trade-off between expressivity and circuit efficiency by reducing the circuit's dimensionality. When comparing the two approaches, we find that the small residual Weyl parameters neglected by the latter are essential for high compression of the Ising propagator, whereas for the Heisenberg propagator, the native XXZ structure can be exploited directly to build a more efficient compressed circuit.

summaries.en: The paper shows that Riemannian-optimized two-qubit gates have an exploitable Weyl-chamber (local Cartan) structure tied to the target Ising or Heisenberg models, and it finds that optimizing directly in the hardware-native gate set can improve compression for the Heisenberg case but loses crucial residual Weyl parameters needed for strong Ising compression.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，里奇曼优化得到的两比特门具有与目标伊辛或海森堡模型相关的可利用魏尔室（局部卡坦）结构，并发现直接在硬件原生门集上优化在海森堡情形下能提升压缩效果，但会忽略对强伊辛压缩至关重要的残余魏尔参数。

title: Modular optical fault-tolerant quantum computation via an interface between verified resources and online logical operations
abstract: We introduce a factory--processor interface architecture for modular optical fault-tolerant quantum computation that separates code-dependent encoded-resource preparation from reusable online logical processing on a common Gaussian optical processor. Beyond encoded resources, the interface specifies logical outputs, code-to-mode mapping, measurement roles, frame updates, verification records, and resource-injection boundaries. As a concrete realization, we combine an offline verified Bell-resource factory based on a recursively concatenated $C_4$ code with physical Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill (GKP) qubits with an online time-domain measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) processor. Under the specified additive-displacement-noise model and fixed postselection policy, simulations support the finite-level logical Bell-error ordering $P_5<P_4<P_3<P_2$ at 12.25 dB of effective GKP displacement-noise quality, both with and without the prescribed additional post-injection displacement noise. At 15.6 dB and $L=2$, a separate fixed-sample evaluation gives one-sided 95$\%$ Clopper--Pearson upper bounds below $10^{-5}$ for both conditions under the binomial model. The interface supports address-tracked injection, transversal CNOT and logical Bell-measurement constructions, and logical SWAP and Hadamard constructions with tracked code permutations. Given advance resource preparation and sufficient routing parallelism, increasing the concatenation level expands parallel encoded-resource width without increasing the protected online sequence length of these constructions. These results identify a modular route to lower logical error rates while retaining a common Gaussian MBQC operation set with shallow online processing.

summaries.en: The paper presents a factory–processor interface architecture for modular optical fault-tolerant quantum computation that decouples code-dependent verified resource preparation from reusable Gaussian online logical operations, demonstrated by combining an offline verified Bell-resource factory using recursively concatenated C4 codes with online time-domain GKP-based MBQC, yielding simulation results consistent with ordered logical Bell-error rates (P5<P4<P3<P2) at 12.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种工厂–处理器接口架构，用于模块化光学容错量子计算：将与编码相关的已验证资源制备与可复用的高斯在线逻辑处理解耦，并以“基于递归级联 C4 码的离线已验证贝尔资源工厂”与“基于 GKP 的时间域测量型量子计算（MBQC）在线处理器”的组合作为具体实现，在 12.

title: Hardware-Friendly Estimation of LCU-Based Expectation Values via Quantum-to-Classical Workload Shifting
abstract: Estimating the expectation value of an observable $O$ for a quantum state evolved under a general, possibly non-unitary, operator $A$ is a fundamental task in quantum simulation, chemistry, and variational algorithms. Existing linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) approaches implement $A$ on hardware, requiring ancilla qubits, controlled unitaries and, in randomized variants, fresh circuit executions for every Monte Carlo sample. These costs are prohibitive on NISQ and early fault-tolerant devices. We propose HERMES (Hardware-Efficient Reusable Measurements for Estimating LCU-based expectation valueS), which moves the processing of $A$ entirely to the classical domain. Expanding $A$ and $O$ in the Pauli basis and sampling pairs of Pauli terms classically, HERMES rewrites $\mu = \mathrm{Tr}(OA\rho A^{\dagger})/\mathrm{Tr}(A\rho A^{\dagger})$ as a ratio of weighted sums of Pauli expectation values on the unmodified state $\rho$, with no ancillas, controlled unitaries, or quantum implementation of $A$. A two-level measurement reduction scheme (Pauli deduplication and commuting-group partitioning) bounds the number of distinct measurement settings independently of the sample count, unlike randomized LCU methods whose circuit executions grow linearly with it. On ground-state energy estimation of $\mathrm{H}_2$ and $\mathrm{LiH}$ via imaginary-time evolution, HERMES matches or beats Pauli single-ancilla LCU baseline using shallow circuits with no two-qubit gates beyond state preparation under qubit-wise commuting grouping. It is also more robust to noise and completes a noisy $\mathrm{LiH}$ simulation infeasible for the baseline, at the cost of classical overhead growing with the number of Pauli terms in $A$.

summaries.en: The paper introduces HERMES, a hardware-friendly method that estimates LCU-based expectation values by shifting the implementation of a general operator A from quantum hardware to classical Pauli-term sampling and ratio reweighting, reducing measurement settings via deduplication and commuting-group partitioning and achieving comparable or better performance on H2 and LiH imaginary-time ground-state energy estimation with greater noise robustness than a Pauli single-ancilla LCU baseline at the expense of increased classical overhead.
summaries.zh: 论文提出HERMES方法，通过将一般算符A的实现从量子硬件转移到经典域的Pauli项采样与加权比值计算，来估计LCU方案的期望值；该方法利用Pauli去重与交换分组限制测量设置数量，并在H2与LiH的虚时演化基态能量估计中用更浅的电路（且state preparation之外不需两比特门）达到或优于Pauli单辅助比特LCU基线，同时对噪声更鲁棒，但代价是随A中Pauli项数量增长的经典计算开销。

title: Generating entanglement in quantum matter with pathway-entangled photons via resonant inelastic X-ray scattering
abstract: Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) is conventionally used to probe elementary excitations and correlations in quantum materials. Here, we propose an interferometric RIXS protocol that instead creates entanglement between spatially separated regions of a solid-state material. An incident X-ray photon is coherently split by a beam splitter into two arms illuminating opposite ends of a sample. Recombining the scattered photons at a second beam splitter and detecting an energy-selected photon then projects the material into a coherent superposition of excitations at the two ends. This protocol is the X-ray, solid-state analogue of the Duan-Lukin-Cirac-Zoller (DLCZ) heralding scheme. Using a Kramers-Heisenberg formalism with quantized photon modes, we show that orthogonal and degenerate end excitations yield maximally entangled states. We illustrate this mechanism in three models: (1) two decoupled sites yield a heralded Bell state. (2) An open tight-binding chain exhibits reflection-parity-dependent interference, providing a benchmark for the interferometer's coherence. (3) A spin-1 Haldane (AKLT) chain yields an entangled pair of fractionalized edge spins. We also discuss practical considerations and challenges for realizing the protocol in X-ray experiments.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: The paper proposes an interferometric resonant inelastic X-ray scattering scheme that uses pathway-entangled photons to herald and generate entanglement between spatially separated excitations in a solid-state sample, analyzed via a quantized Kramers–Heisenberg framework and demonstrated in several toy models including maximally entangled Bell states and edge-spin entanglement in a spin-1 Haldane (AKLT) chain.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种基于路径纠缠光子的干涉式共振非弹性X射线散射方案，通过能量选择的检测在固体样品中空间分离的激发之间产生可望（heralded）的纠缠，并用量子化的Kramers–Heisenberg形式主义进行分析，同时在多个模型中展示其机制，包括产生最大纠缠的贝尔态以及在自旋1哈达内（AKLT）链中实现分数化边缘自旋的纠缠。

title: Low-frustration block encodings by patch routing
abstract: Block-encoding has emerged as a core primitive in many quantum algorithms, including quantum simulation. In this work, we design efficient and extensible methods for generating low-frustration block encodings of frustrated lattice Hamiltonians built from repeated local interaction patches through a technique we call "patch routing". We construct block encodings for a full Hamiltonian by first block-encoding a small local patch and then using a SWAP-style routing network to coherently apply the local patch encoding across the lattice. The expensive, local block-encoding cost is paid only once per query and is independent of lattice size, whereas the comparatively inexpensive routing network grows linearly with the lattice size, dominating at large sizes. Our method allows for a hierarchical structure in which larger patches can be block-encoded with small normalization factors, albeit at a higher (local, non-extensive) block-encoding cost, thereby reducing overall query complexity in an algorithm. We exploit symmetries and algebraic structures in local interactions to construct efficient block encodings, and we apply these techniques to the Heisenberg, Fermi-Hubbard, and honeycomb spin-liquid models. For a $120\times 120$ square-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model near maximal frustration ($J_2/J_1=0.4-0.6$), our methods result in a $15-17\times$ reduction in the leading $T$ cost per qubitized-QPE run (ignoring initial state preparation and overlap) relative to prior state-of-the-art Pauli LCU constructions. Corresponding reductions are approximately $3\times$ for the $120\times120$ Fermi-Hubbard model at half-filling. For time evolution of the honeycomb spin-liquid model on $120\times120$ unit cells, the leading cost is reduced by $5\times$. Our framework provides a systematic way forward for larger and more accurate fault-tolerant simulations of real-world quantum systems.

summaries.en: The paper proposes patch-routing techniques to build low-frustration block encodings for frustrated lattice Hamiltonians by block-encoding small local interaction patches once and coherently routing them across the lattice, reducing query complexity via hierarchical larger-patch encodings and symmetry-based constructions, with sizable T-cost improvements demonstrated for Heisenberg, Fermi-Hubbard, and honeycomb spin-liquid models on 120×120 lattices.
summaries.zh: 本文提出“补丁路由”方法，通过只对小局域相互作用补丁做一次高效块编码，再用类SWAP的相干路由网络将该补丁编码应用到整个晶格上，从而为具有低挫折度的受挫晶格哈密顿量构造低挫折块编码，并利用局域相互作用的对称性与代数结构实现分层的大补丁编码以进一步降低整体查询复杂度；在120×120的Heisenberg、Fermi-Hubbard和蜂窝自旋液模型中，T成本分别实现了约15–17倍、约3倍和约5倍的主要开销降低，为更大规模、更高精度且面向真实量子系统的容错仿真提供了系统路径。

title: Single-step SU(3) Hahn Echo in a Qutrit Atom Interferometer
abstract: The Hahn echo is a well-known dynamical decoupling method that refocuses the dephasing due to energy inhomogeneities of a spin-1/2 ensemble and is widely used to extend phase coherence in quantum computers and sensors. Extensions of such techniques beyond the spin-1/2 have been reported, but have mainly used SU(2) gates, limiting their scalability. Here, we generalize the Hahn echo to qutrits using single-step SU(3) gates and extend the coherence time by more than an order of magnitude. The gates are generated through optimal control theory and implemented in an ultracold atomic ensemble in free fall. A quantum process tomography procedure benchmarks the gates and yields fidelities of ~ 93%, limited mainly by state preparation and measurement errors. Due to the geometry of the laser beams, the generalized Hahn echo also realizes a three-path Mach-Zehnder atomic interferometer with two independent interferometric phase differences. Our results therefore establish SU(3) control for dynamical decoupling of qutrits and multi-path atom interferometers, with the latter opening the possibility for vector force measurements and interferometric tests of the validity of Born's rule.

summaries.en: The paper generalizes the Hahn echo to a qutrit by implementing single-step SU(3) dynamical-decoupling gates generated via optimal control in an ultracold atom interferometer, extending coherence by over an order of magnitude and achieving ~93% process-tomography fidelities while enabling a three-path Mach-Zehnder interferometer with two independently tunable phase differences.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过在超冷原子干涉仪中用基于最优控制理论生成的单步SU(3)门实现对qutrit的哈恩回波广义化，从而将相干时间延长超过一个数量级，并通过量子过程层析测得约93%的保真度，同时利用激光束几何实现具有两个独立相位差的三路径马赫-曾德尔干涉仪，为矢量力测量与玻恩规则有效性检验提供可能。

title: A Compact Single-Beam Optically Pumped Magnetometer Based on Absorption Detection
abstract: We demonstrate a compact single-beam optically pumped magnetometer (OPM) employing a pure 87Rb microfabricated vapor cell with 500 Torr buffer gas. The residual magnetic field is actively minimized to below 400 pT through a combination of mu-metal magnetic shielding and internal compensation coils. We systematically characterize the OPM response as a function of laser detuning and optical intensity, and derive the magnetic-field sensitivity from the signal slope and noise amplitude spectral density. A best sensitivity of 11 fT/Hz^1/2 is achieved near the resonance transition at an optimal optical intensity, using a small cell volume of only 0.027 cm^3. Furthermore, a miniaturized OPM prototype was developed using a folded flexible printed circuit board (FPCB) to integrate the vapor cell, a compact heater, and magnetic-field coils into a cubic sensing head. Two coil configurations patterned directly on the FPCB were investigated. Under optimized operating conditions, the OPM prototype achieved a sensitivity of 66 fT/Hz^1/2. These results demonstrate that high-buffer-pressure single-beam OPMs can achieve excellent sensitivity, establishing a pathway toward compact and scalable arrays.

summaries.en: The paper presents a compact single-beam 87Rb optically pumped magnetometer using a microfabricated 500-Torr vapor cell with active magnetic shielding and compensation, achieving 11 fT/Hz^1/2 best sensitivity and demonstrating a miniaturized FPCB-based prototype with 66 fT/Hz^1/2 sensitivity for scalable arrays.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于500托纯87Rb微加工气室的紧凑单光束光泵磁力计，通过μ金属屏蔽与内部补偿线圈主动降低残余磁场，并在小体积气室下获得最佳11 fT/Hz^1/2灵敏度，同时开发了基于折叠柔性印刷电路板（FPCB）的微型原型，其在优化条件下实现66 fT/Hz^1/2灵敏度，展示了通向可扩展阵列的路径。
